ValidationRule.description: Requires a Follow Up Date whenever a wealth prospect is in Nurturing status, on the four wealth prospect record types. Mirrors Lead.Follow_Up_Date_Required_for_Nurturing but enforces on every save, so the date cannot be cleared afterward.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Business", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Retirement_Plan", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Trust", RecordType.DeveloperName = "PersonAccount" ), ISPICKVAL(Prospect_Status__c, "Nurturing"), ISBLANK(Follow_Up_Date__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please specify a Follow Up Date for Nurturing Status.
